thread:
ella: midweek pets parade! drop one pic/gif of your pet doing something delightfully ridiculous. crown emoji to the top silliness :crown:
rafael: kicking off with Popcorn the guinea pig demonstrating the legendary zoom-and-stop. seriously unstoppable. gif: https://imgur.com/popcorn-zoom.gif :popcorn:
toni: Miso the cat found my winter mitten and insists it's now a hat. refuses to move until offered tuna. pic: https://photos.example/miso-mitten.jpg :cat_with_wry_smile:
alex: Ravi the parrot doing a flawless impression of our onboarding chime. audio: https://files.redwood/ravi-chime.mp3 also he says "cookie" on demand which is terrifyingly accurate :parrot:
danny: Volt the corgi performed a perfect wiggle-bow sequence after I said "walk". tiny feet, big enthusiasm. video: https://videos.example/volt-wiggle.mp4 :dog2:
julia: bonus micro-challenge: most dramatic snack-steal. here's Pixel the ferret mid-heist with a croissant. please admire the intensity. https://i.imgur.com/pixel-heist.jpg :eyes:
ella: quick poll: react with :crown: for Popcorn, :mittens: for Miso, :musical_note: for Ravi, :zap: for Volt, :detective: for Pixel. will close in 2 hours.
dev-bot: poll created (2h)  Popcorn (guinea pig) / Miso (cat) / Ravi (parrot) / Volt (corgi) / Pixel (ferret)
rafael: also, Popcorn demands a tiny parade float. currently crafting with a shoebox and dragon stickers. will post update if it survives the living room stadium :sparkles:
toni: mite-sized fashion show incoming. Miso modeling mitten couture at 3pm GMT :hat_with_ribbon:
alex: ravi update: taught him to do a dramatic drumroll. dangerous but impressive. clip: https://cdn.example/ravi-drumroll.mp4 :drum:
danny: Volt update: he fell asleep mid-wiggle, ten points for commitment. photo: https://imgur.com/volt-snooze.jpg :zzz:
julia: Pixel accepted bribe of peanut and immediately forgave us. ferret diplomacy works. :peanuts:
dev-bot: poll closed  results: Popcorn 8, Miso 11, Ravi 4, Volt 5, Pixel 2. Winner: Miso (cat) :trophy:
ella: MITTEN CAT WINS. awarding digital crown and a permanent mitten emoji in #random. thanks for the smiles, team :heart_eyes:
toni: thank you!! Miso demands a victory nap and a tuna snack. photo evidence incoming after nap :camera_with_flash:
rafael: shoebox float update: it survived one dramatic tumble but Popcorn approves. sending victory lap video tomorrow :bowing_man:
julia: night all, dream of tiny pet parades :crescent_moon:
